title: Filters
summary: Digital-signal treatments shown on the sample clip: glitches for cuts, signal looks for “screen” moments, and a cold grade as the base look. Previews run at full strength; use far less in a video.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"name": "rgb_split", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.3, "amount": 0.8}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "glitch", "amount": 0.6, "where": "in"}}. Engine: library/_shared/effects_engine.py (OpenCV).

items.name: rgb split
items.description: Red and blue slide apart sideways for a hard chromatic split.

items.name: glitch
items.description: Rows of the picture jump sideways with color fringing.

items.name: pixelate
items.description: The picture collapses into large blocks.

items.name: pixel stretch
items.description: One column of pixels smeared across the frame.

items.name: vhs
items.description: Tape playback: colour bleed, a rolling tracking band and noise.

items.name: chroma bars
items.description: Vertical strips slip up and down with colour fringes.

items.name: hologram
items.description: Cyan projection: tint, scanlines and jittering rows.

items.name: scanlines
items.description: Fine rolling horizontal lines.

items.name: crt
items.description: Curved monitor: bulge, scanlines and fringing.

items.name: neon edges
items.description: Glowing outlines traced along edges.

items.name: night vision
items.description: Green phosphor scope with grain and a circular falloff.

items.name: thermal
items.description: False-colour heat camera.

items.name: edge hud
items.description: The picture darkens and its outlines redraw in glowing cyan.

items.name: cool grade
items.description: A cold, contrasty grade with teal in the shadows. The theme’s base look for footage.

items.name: duotone
items.description: Two-color treatment: navy shadows, mint highlights.

items.name: vignette
items.description: Darkened corners that pull the eye inward.

items.name: grain
items.description: Fine monochrome grain.

items.name: cyber poster
items.description: Flattens the picture into bands of the theme colours.

items.name: halftone
items.description: A screen of cyan dots sized by brightness.

items.name: neon bloom
items.description: Highlights bleed cyan and mid-tones magenta: a neon haze.

items.name: flash
items.description: A cyan-white flash for hard cuts.

items.name: zoom blur
items.description: A radial punch toward the centre.

items.name: whip
items.description: Sideways motion blur for a whip cut.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
